hooks.command: name=$(basename "$PWD"); [ "$name" = "DeniDin" ] && name="root"; f=".claude/personalities/$name.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || f=".claude/personalities/default.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then jq -Rs --arg src "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Personality file (\($src)):\n\n" + .)}}' < "$f"; fi

for f in .github/CONSTITUTION.md .github/METHODOLOGY.md .github/ARCHITECTURE.md .github/BUG_DRIVEN_DEVELOPMENT.md .github/TDD-ENFORCEMENT.md; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; }; done | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'
